text:
liz: FYI team  SpringHarbor private/VPC onboarding preflight. Dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need a quick sweep: peering parity to analytics, NAT capacity (burst plan?), KMS CMK policy (cloudtrail + redwood-audit grants), and audit-bucket lifecycle. Tagging @omar @natalie @priya :eyes:

omar: On it. Prioritize prod-app, prod-worker, and cache-private. I'll enumerate peering connections, route tables, and NATs and flag anything routed to IGW that should be private.

natalie: I'll validate CloudTrail -> S3 sink, check bucket encryption and lifecycle. Procurement asked for 7-year retention as an option. Need to confirm cross-account replication constraints.

priya: KMS checklist: key state, creation date, rotation enabled, CMK policy includes CloudTrail service principal and the redwood-audit role. If there's a Lambda requiring decrypt, prefer creating a limited grant instead of widening key policy.

omar: Quick inventory commands I ran: `aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=status-code,Values=active` and `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0spring1`

omar: Found peering pcx-0fa1b2 attached to analytics-vpc but prod-app-rtb missing the peer route. I'll add route now and record change id.

omar: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3 --destination-cidr-block 10.70.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0fa1b2` -> change chg-0e4f5d6a

ops-bot: infra-bot: Route create event recorded (chg-0e4f5d6a) by omar at 2026-03-27T18:02:11Z

natalie: CloudTrail exists (springharbor-audit), bucket springharbor-audit-us-east-1. Bucket default encryption is AES256 currently; not using KMS. Lifecycle is 365d. Will propose enabling SSE-KMS with new alias `alias/springharbor-audit-kms` and a one-off re-encrypt S3 job.

priya: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:777788889999:key/1a2b3c created 2024-08-19. Policy missing cloudtrail.amazonaws.com principal. Suggested snippet to add to CMK policy:

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowCloudTrailService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "Service": "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com" },
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

priya: Also ensure `arn:aws:iam::777788889999:role/redwood-audit` is in the key policy with DescribeKey/CreateGrant/Decrypt actions. Capture creation date for compliance sheet.

omar: NATs: Two NATs in us-east-1 (nat-0a11, nat-0b22). Analytics subnets pointed to IGW by mistake earlier; switched to NAT and queued smoke tests. Also flagged sg-0ff112 with broad egress 0.0.0.0/0 UDP ephemeral on prod-worker.

liz: please tighten that SG and upload the export link. We need artifacts for the ticket.

omar: uploaded gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/springharbor-net-export (contains SGs, NACLs, NAT list, route-table snapshots).

ops-bot: compliance-bot: KMS policy PR #4783 opened by priya (adds CloudTrail principal + redwood-audit role)

natalie: retention note: customer wants 7y option. If we switch bucket lifecycle to 7y and enable SSE-KMS there are costs + cross-account considerations. I'll add a short migration plan to the runbook: create KMS alias, update CloudTrail, enable bucket default encryption, run `aws s3 cp s3://springharbor-audit s3://springharbor-audit --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/springharbor-audit-kms --recursive` with a staged approach.

liz: Renewal risk: procurement asked for HSM-backed keys and an SLA addendum. Marking renewal risk as "elevated" until solutions provides cost delta and timeline. Can Solutions draft the HSM option and delta? Tagging @solutions (will follow up).

priya: For the Lambda in analytics needing decrypt, I'll create a constrained grant: `aws kms create-grant --key-id ... --grantee-principal arn:aws:lambda:...:function:analytics-decrypt --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"service":"analytics"}` instead of broad policy changes.

omar: smoke tests queued after NAT + route fixes, will post results here shortly.

natalie: CloudTrail + KMS changes staged in staging only for dry-run. I'll push the S3 lifecycle/sample re-encrypt steps into the runbook and attach to the dry-run checklist.

liz: thanks team. I'll update the onboarding runbook, attach the gist, add the renewal risk card to the customer health dashboard (elevated/HSM request), and send the runbook to SpringHarbor ops for acknowledgement. Dry-run scheduled 09:30 PT tomorrow. Closing this sync. :thumbsup:
